<Aside type="caution" title="VITE_ values are public and fixed at build time">
Vite inlines every `VITE_*` variable into the JavaScript bundle when you build.
Anything prefixed `VITE_` ships to every browser, so never put a secret there.
And a built bundle (or image) is pinned to the values it was built with:
changing them at runtime does nothing. Build one bundle per environment.
</Aside>

Generation copies `.env.example` to `.env`. In development, Vite reads it on
start; restart `yarn dev` after changing it.

<EnvTable template="react-app" />

## Not in `.env.example`

There is deliberately no `VITE_APP_URL`: absolute links (email verification
callbacks) use `window.location.origin`. A stale URL baked into an image would
send every verification link to the previous environment, invisibly, until a
user clicked one.

## What the API must agree with

- The API's trusted origins and CORS must include this app's origin (for local
  development, `http://localhost:3000`), with credentials allowed and the
  `traceparent` header permitted. See [Auth, cookies and
  CORS](../../../services/auth-domains/).
- better-auth must be served at `${VITE_APP_API_URL}/auth`.
- With `types`, the API's OpenAPI document at `API_DOC_URL`, behind the basic
  auth in `API_DOC_USER` and `API_DOC_PASSWORD`.
